definition.target_policy: exact target relation absent from clean2023; target relations never enter context
definition.pair_score: mean of the available standardized terms: candidate enzyme against the reaction train-known-enzyme prototype, and candidate reaction against the enzyme train-known-reaction prototype
definition.symmetry: same pair evidence in R2E and E2R
definition.missing_policy: each missing side is neutral zero; if both sides are unavailable the expert is silent
definition.permission: protect ranks 1-5; only reorder ranks 6-100; ranks above 100 remain unchanged
definition.selection_surface: firewalled source-expansion relations disjoint from all frozen outer target relations
definition.selection_rule: one shared alpha/prefix for both directions; MRR, Hit@10/100/1000 and median-rank non-regression constraints
